delta_mfe.formula_ref: y_mfe_r(long) - y_mfe_r(short) at the same decision_ts

labels.y_definition: y = ΔMFE = clean_labels y_mfe_r on the long row minus y_mfe_r on the short row at the same decision_ts. y_mfe_r is TN_ENV_CLEAN_L2 horizon_excursion mfe_r (exit-agnostic, max_forward=40), NOT stream mfe, NOT y_tp1, NOT y_R_net.
labels.sign_convention: Positive ΔMFE means the long path printed more favorable R-excursion than the short path over the next 40 bars

components.name: not_a_trade
components.bps_or_formula: ΔMFE is not book PnL. No spread, commission, or slippage is applied. SEM-015 is OUT OF PATH.

exits.intrabar_rule: Inherited from the sealed clean_labels protocol (horizon_excursion, exit-agnostic). This experiment does not re-walk SL/TP. It does not use opportunities.outcome.
not_equal_to: forward_walk net R as this y

splits.embargo: 96 M15 bars between last train timestamp and first holdout timestamp
splits.purge: drop train pairs whose 40-bar horizon overlaps holdout start
splits.oos_fraction_or_dates: last 20% of corpus bars by index; first holdout timestamp 2025-12-24 19:15:00 (idx 37820). F-086 stride holdout of 236 bars is a different split and is not spent. The 2026-08-24 full-sample atlas is not this split.

metrics.success_gate: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Holdout n_pairs>=30 AND both trend_bias=+1 and −1 cells n>=30 AND sign(holdout contrast)==sign(train contrast), where contrast=E[ΔMFE|trend_bias=+1]−E[ΔMFE|trend_bias=−1]. Meeting every clause is NOT economic validation while economic_claims_allowed is false. Session and hour cells are reported, never gated.
metrics.kill_criteria: Any outcome including n=0 or n<30 is registered. Changing y (to y_tp1 or stream mfe), pairing rule, PRIMARY state, holdout date, embargo, or purge after seeing holdout y requires a NEW MC-* id. Do not promote session/hour into PRIMARY after seeing them.
